# Xuanbao Environmental Technology

> Yancheng Xuanbao Environmental Technology Co., Ltd. — manufacturer of industrial
> emission control materials: SCR DeNOx catalysts, CO oxidation catalysts, VOC
> oxidation catalysts, zeolite molecular sieves and activated carbon. This file
> lists the primary pages of xuanbaoenvironment.com; deep technical documentation
> lives in the companion knowledge center at data.xuanbaoenvironment.com.

## Core pages

- [Home](https://xuanbaoenvironment.com/): company overview, product categories, industries and R&D/quality workflow.
- [Products](https://xuanbaoenvironment.com/products/): 14 products across 5 categories — SCR DeNOx, CO removal, VOC catalysts, molecular sieves, activated carbon.
- [SCR DeNOx Catalysts](https://xuanbaoenvironment.com/products/scr-denox-catalysts/): plate-type and honeycomb V-Mo-Ti catalysts.
- [VOC Catalysts](https://xuanbaoenvironment.com/products/voc-catalysts/): Pt, Pt-Pd and non-precious-metal honeycomb catalysts.
- [Zeolite Molecular Sieves](https://xuanbaoenvironment.com/products/zeolite-molecular-sieve/): modified 5A, 13X, ZSM-5 and NaY.
- [Activated Carbon](https://xuanbaoenvironment.com/products/activated-carbon/): honeycomb, coal-based columnar, coconut shell and fiber.
- [CO Removal Catalyst](https://xuanbaoenvironment.com/products/co-removal-catalyst/): CO oxidation for sintering, incineration and furnace exhaust.
- [Solutions](https://xuanbaoenvironment.com/solutions/): SCR DeNOx, VOC catalytic oxidation, adsorption + catalytic combustion, molecular sieve concentration, CO removal.
- [Industries](https://xuanbaoenvironment.com/industries/): thermal power, steel, sintering, cement, alumina, petrochemical, chemical, coating, printing, pharmaceutical, automotive, waste incineration.
- [Case Studies](https://xuanbaoenvironment.com/case-studies/): field test records — sintering machine CO removal, medical waste incinerator CO removal.
- [About](https://xuanbaoenvironment.com/about/), [R&D](https://xuanbaoenvironment.com/r-and-d/), [Manufacturing](https://xuanbaoenvironment.com/manufacturing/), [Quality](https://xuanbaoenvironment.com/quality/), [Service](https://xuanbaoenvironment.com/service/)
- [Contact](https://xuanbaoenvironment.com/contact/): inquiry form for gas conditions and quotations.
- [Resources](https://xuanbaoenvironment.com/resources/): link to the knowledge center.

## Technical documentation

- [Knowledge Center](https://data.xuanbaoenvironment.com/): six pillar guides (SCR DeNOx, CO oxidation, VOC catalysts, molecular sieves, activated carbon, VOC engineering) with 25+ cluster articles.
- [Knowledge Center llms.txt](https://data.xuanbaoenvironment.com/llms.txt): full index of technical articles.
